metadata.title: EMRS :Unfulfilled Promise of Modi Government | एकलव्य स्कूल : आदिवासियों से मोदी जी का वादा अधूरा
metadata.description: EMRS (Eklavya Model Residential Schools) are imparting quality education in tribal areas of the country. Recognising the contribution of these schools Modi government announced in 2018 to establish 462 EMRS in every tribal block of the country. The year 2022 was the deadline to achieve this goal by the government. 2022 has come to an end but this promise is yet to be fulfilled.
